## [1.4.1](https://github.com/V4n1X/morphe-patches/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1) (2026-11-06)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **soundcloud:** support November release and black out mini-player on AMOLED ([149ea4a](https://github.com/V4n1X/morphe-patches/commit/149ea4a3b7bf1b196d78100bddcdc781752625b7)), closes [#5](https://github.com/V4n1X/morphe-patches/issues/5) [#6](https://github.com/V4n1X/morphe-patches/issues/6) [#7](https://github.com/V4n1X/morphe-patches/issues/7)

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Changes the default dark theme to use true blacks for AMOLED screens.

patches.name: Disable consent popup
patches.description: Disables the OneTrust consent/cookies popup and collapses banner views.

patches.name: Enable SoundCloud Go+
patches.description: Enables SoundCloud Go+ premium features, offline listening, HQ audio, and disables audio/visual ads.

patches.name: Material You dynamic theme
patches.description: Applies Android 12+ Material You dynamic accent colors from the system wallpaper palette.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables AdMob banner, interstitial and rewarded ads, removes sponsored/promotional banners, and skips advertising consent prompts.
